item.title: Cricketer Rinku Singh's Father Passes Away Due to Prolonged Illness
item.description: GUWAHATI: Indian cricketer Rinku Singh’s father Khanchand Singh breathed his last at a hospital in Greater Noida early on Friday, February 27 due to a prolonged illness. Rinku’s father was suffering from liver cancer and was admitted to the Yatharth Hospital where he passed away.
